penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to file return
penalty_rules.base_description: Net amount of tax required to be shown on the return (reduced by timely payments and credits) - IRC 6651(b)(1)
penalty_rules.rate: 5% per month or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: If return filed more than 60 days after due date (with extensions): not less than the lesser of the versioned minimum_amount (see 6651a1_min rows) or 100% of tax required to be shown
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Reduced by 6651(a)(2) amount for any month both apply - IRC 6651(c)(1); combined effective rate 4.5%/month for first 5 months; offset may not reduce below the 60-day minimum
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to file - 60-day minimum (versioned)
penalty_rules.base_description: Minimum addition under IRC 6651(a) last sentence for returns due in calendar year 2020
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: Lesser of minimum_amount or 100% of tax required to be shown on the return; applies only when return is filed more than 60 days after the due date (determined with extensions)
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Floor survives the 6651(c)(1) offset - IRC 6651(c)(1) last sentence
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B)
penalty_rules.authority_cite: IRC 6651(a), (j); IRS Failure to File Penalty page

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Fraudulent failure to file
penalty_rules.base_description: Net amount of tax required to be shown on the return - IRC 6651(b)(1) as applied through 6651(a)(1)
penalty_rules.rate: 15% per month or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Substitutes for 6651(a)(1) rates when failure is fraudulent; 6651(c)(1) offset applies to the substituted addition
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B) (imposed under 6651(a)(1) as modified by 6651(f))
penalty_rules.authority_cite: IRC 6651(f)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to pay tax shown on return
penalty_rules.base_description: Amount shown as tax on return, reduced month-by-month by payments and credits - IRC 6651(b)(2)
penalty_rules.rate: 0.5% per month or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Offsets 6651(a)(1) for overlapping months - IRC 6651(c)(1); rate variants: 6651a2_ia (0.25%) and 6651a2_levy (1%)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Only if unpaid 21 calendar days after notice and demand (10 business days if amount >= $100,000); interest runs from notice-and-demand date - IRC 6601(e)(2)(A)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to pay - installment agreement rate (individuals)
penalty_rules.base_description: Same base as 6651a2; individual must have filed the return on or before its due date (with extensions)
penalty_rules.rate: 0.25% per month or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Applies only for months during which an IRC 6159 installment agreement is in effect
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Only if unpaid 21 calendar days after notice and demand (10 business days if amount >= $100,000); interest runs from notice-and-demand date - IRC 6601(e)(2)(A)
penalty_rules.authority_cite: IRC 6651(h)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to pay - increased rate after levy notice
penalty_rules.base_description: Same base as 6651a2 / 6651a3
penalty_rules.rate: 1% per month or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Applies to months beginning after the earlier of (a) 10 days after notice under IRC 6331(d) (intent to levy) or (b) notice and demand for immediate payment under IRC 6331(a)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Only if unpaid 21 calendar days after notice and demand (10 business days if amount >= $100,000); interest runs from notice-and-demand date - IRC 6601(e)(2)(A)
penalty_rules.authority_cite: IRC 6651(d)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to pay amount stated in notice and demand
penalty_rules.base_description: Amount of tax stated in notice and demand, reduced by payments made before the month - IRC 6651(b)(3)
penalty_rules.rate: 0.5% per month or fraction thereof (1% after levy notice per 6651(d))
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Runs only if amount not paid within 21 calendar days of notice and demand (10 business days if >= $100,000)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Only if unpaid 21 calendar days after notice and demand (10 business days if amount >= $100,000); interest runs from notice-and-demand date - IRC 6601(e)(2)(A)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Combined-penalty offset rule (not a standalone penalty)
penalty_rules.base_description: Interaction rule between 6651(a)(1) and 6651(a)(2)/(a)(3)
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: Offset may not reduce 6651(a)(1) below the 60-day minimum amount
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: For any month to which both 6651(a)(1) and 6651(a)(2) apply, the (a)(1) addition is reduced by the (a)(2) addition for that month

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Accuracy-related penalty
penalty_rules.base_description: Portion of underpayment attributable to negligence, disregard of rules, substantial understatement, substantial valuation misstatement, etc. - IRC 6662(b)
penalty_rules.cap: No aggregate cap; applies per portion of underpayment
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: No stacking with 6663 on the same portion of underpayment - IRC 6663(b) coordination; substantial-understatement thresholds in 6662(d)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B) (chapter 68 subchapter A part II penalty)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Accuracy-related penalty - gross valuation misstatement
penalty_rules.base_description: Portion of underpayment attributable to a gross valuation misstatement (value/ basis claimed 200%+ of correct amount, and related thresholds) - IRC 6662(e), (g), (h)
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: No penalty if portion of underpayment attributable to the misstatement does not exceed $5,000 ($10,000 for most corporations) - IRC 6662(h)(2) / (e)(2)
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Replaces the 20% rate for the gross-misstatement portion
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B) (chapter 68 subchapter A part II penalty)
penalty_rules.authority_cite: IRC 6662(h)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Fraud penalty
penalty_rules.base_description: Portion of underpayment attributable to fraud
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: Once any portion is shown attributable to fraud, entire underpayment treated as attributable to fraud unless taxpayer establishes otherwise - IRC 6663(b)
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Portion subject to 6663 is excluded from 6662 - IRC 6662 coordination via 6663(b)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Return due date including extensions - IRC 6601(e)(2)(B) (chapter 68 subchapter A part II penalty)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Estimated tax addition - individuals
penalty_rules.base_description: Underpayment of each required installment (Form 2210 method); payments credited to earliest unpaid installment - IRC 6654(b)
penalty_rules.rate: IRC 6621 underpayment rate in effect for the period (quarterly; see rates.csv)
penalty_rules.cap: Runs from installment due date to earlier of payment date or April 15 of following year
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: No addition if total tax less credits/withholding is under $1,000 - IRC 6654(e)(1); safe harbors in 6654(d)
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Computed like interest but NOT compounded daily - IRC 6622(b) exception; no interest is charged on the addition itself - IRC 6601(h)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: n/a - the addition is itself interest-like and bears no interest

penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Computed like interest but NOT compounded daily - IRC 6622(b) exception; no interest on the addition itself - IRC 6601(h)
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: n/a - the addition is itself interest-like and bears no interest

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Failure to file return (late filing penalty)
penalty_rules.base_description: Total tax shown on the return (income tax; Puerto Rico Internal Revenue Code of 2011)
penalty_rules.rate: 5% if failure is not more than 30 days, plus 10% for each additional 30 days or fraction thereof
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: Reasonable-cause exception applies
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Progressive (stepped) rate, not a flat 5%/month; interest and surcharges under Sec. 6030.02 apply separately
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Not verified - see Missing list
penalty_rules.authority_cite: Puerto Rico Internal Revenue Code of 2011 (Act 1-2011), Sec. 6030.11(a)

penalty_rules.penalty_name: Late payment surcharge (recargo)
penalty_rules.base_description: Tax balance not paid by its due date
penalty_rules.rate: 5% of amount due if delay exceeds 30 days but not 60 days; 10% of amount due if delay exceeds 60 days
penalty_rules.minimum_rule: No surcharge if delay is 30 days or less
penalty_rules.stacking_or_offset_rule: Applies in every case where interest under Sec. 6030.02 is imposed; stacks on top of the 10% annual interest
penalty_rules.interest_on_penalty_start: Not verified - see Missing list
penalty_rules.authority_cite: Puerto Rico Internal Revenue Code of 2011 (Act 1-2011), Sec. 6030.02
